name: land_range
_comment: U9 wave 4: landing range vs planet size. Kit Crawler 100 (inertialess, 44 px/s) requests landing (`l`) on the system's only stellar, flies out 12 s (~530 px) in whatever heading it took off with, brakes (Down), turns 180 deg (Left 2.06 s at Turn 30) and flies back at constant speed pressing `l` every ~160 ms (90 presses in one step: a shot step would leave a 2 s gap). Analyse with analysis/planet_track.mjs --events recording.events.json --from <return start>: the last press before the spaceport bounds the range. Pilots w4_land_{40,72,150,250,304,325}.
